result.notes: The menu PDF shows no prices, so all price_eur values are null. Dishes are inferred from the garbled PDF layout; section headers (Salads, Bowls, Curries, Hot Wraps, Kids Menu) are taken from the text. Salads come with crusty country bread, bowls with warm rice and a fresh salad mix, curries with fresh vegetables and jasmine rice, and hot wraps with rice, baby spinach and cherry tomatoes. Kids menu items are skipped as small portions, and drinks, smoothies, sweets and coffee are excluded. The Big Easy Beef Salad description is partly garbled, so its protein is assumed to be beef. Chicken dishes can be made vegan with planted.chicken, but values are for the standard version. Estimates are approximate.
